source.snippet: Our clients regularly get RTBF requests under GDPR and CCPA. We still need to show what was deleted, when, who approved it, and sometimes retain non-personal transaction history for legal reasons. A person submitted an erasure request; the customer deleted the Contact and related Cases. Months later the same person raised a billing dispute. By then the field history and related records were gone.

problem_statement: Companies using Salesforce must simultaneously honor GDPR/CCPA right-to-be-forgotten deletion requests and maintain legally defensible audit trails of what was deleted and why — but Salesforce's native tools do not support this combination, leaving businesses exposed in billing disputes and audits.
target_segment: Salesforce admins and compliance officers at SMB-to-mid-market B2C companies subject to GDPR or CCPA, typically in SaaS, fintech, or e-commerce.
notes: Buyer signal strong: question comes from someone managing client Salesforce orgs (likely a consultant or admin at a company with legal obligations). Describes a real incident (billing dispute after erasure) with concrete legal and financial consequence. Willingness to pay implied by regulatory compliance stakes. Market: Salesforce ISV ecosystem or compliance SaaS.
